description: Data science methodology and method-selection routing for quantitative research. Covers EDA, data validation, descriptive analysis, causal inference (IV, DiD, RD, synthetic control), clustering/PCA/UMAP, supervised ML, geospatial analysis, network analysis, and visualization design. Contains the canonical method-to-library routing tree, routed by execution language — Python: statsmodels (OLS/GLM/time series), pyfixest (FE/DiD), linearmodels (RE/GMM/SUR), svy (complex surveys), scikit-learn (clustering/prediction ML), geopandas (spatial), igraph (network analysis); R: r-stats (OLS/GLM/time series), fixest (FE/DiD), plm (panel/RE/IV), survey-r (complex surveys), tidymodels (ML), sf-terra (spatial), igraph-r (network analysis). Load the routed tool-specific skill before giving tool-specific advice or writing code — library skills encode environment constraints and curated caveats absent from general knowledge.
